personality_one_liner: A premium, Notion-meets-Apple home and family management experience that feels organized, deeply reassuring, and elegantly calm.

spacing.rule: Maintain Apple-like generous vertical padding. Cards should never flush to screen edges. Use intentional whitespace to separate functional sections.

do's: Apply to sticky headers, bottom tab bar, and bottom-sheet drag handles.
Use over the hero financial card background imagery for a premium signature Apple look.
Pair blur with a translucent tinted base (≥70% opacity in light, ≥75% in dark) to guarantee foreground readability.
dont's: Do not apply glass to dense form inputs, simple body text sections, or every individual list row.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A unified dashboard summarizing household health (finances, bills, tasks, shopping, AI motivational snippet).

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner in primary brand color.
states.empty: N/A - This screen populates default summary components.
states.error: Polite error text instructing to reload the dashboard, with a sleek retry button.

screens.layout: Top Header: Greeting, User Avatar (serving as Profile entry), and a subtle 'Acesso Founder' badge. Hero Card (Financial Summary): Image backdrop layered with a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim and a frosted glass panel holding total balance and AI insight. Below Hero: 2-column grid of smart cards (Próximas Contas, Lista de Mercado, Tarefas de Hoje, Calendário) using clean Notion-inspired outlines and high-contrast typography.

screens.name: Finanças
screens.purpose: Deep dive into financial control, shared wallets, bills, income, goals, and AI financial assistant.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the rounded card shapes.
states.empty: Illustration of couple managing finances over coffee, with a call-to-action to 'Adicionar Transação'.
states.error: Error message with a retry button to fetch wallet data.

screens.layout: Top Header: Segmented control (Visão Geral / Metas / Gráficos). Content: Horizontally scrolling wallet cards. Vertical list for recent transactions and due bills. Floating Action Button (FAB) for the 'Assistente IA Financeiro' using a glass blur overlay on brandTertiary tint.

screens.name: Tarefas
screens.purpose: Kanban-style task management with delegation, checklists, and deadlines.

states.empty: Clean empty state illustration. Text: 'Nenhuma tarefa pendente. Aproveite o tempo livre!'

screens.layout: Notion-inspired minimalist layout. Horizontal categories (Todas, Casa, Compras, Filhos) acting as Kanban lanes or tabs. Stacked rows with native-feeling checkboxes, drag-handles, and subtle dividers. An inline 'Adicionar Tarefa' field at the bottom.

screens.name: Mercado
screens.purpose: Shared shopping list organized by category with priority flags.

states.empty: Clean empty state. Text: 'Sua lista de mercado está vazia.'

screens.layout: Block-based list similar to Apple Reminders or Notion. Items grouped by section headers (e.g., 'Hortifruti', 'Limpeza'). Each row features a checkbox, item name, quantity, and an optional subtle photo thumbnail. Floating '+' button.

home_hero.alt: Premium home interior indicating smart home and organized household

finances_empty_state.alt: Couple managing finances and coffee mugs on table

instructions_to_main_agent: All UI copy must be in Portuguese-BR.
STRICT BOTTOM TABS ANTI-PATTERN RULE: Do not use 6 bottom tabs as requested. Use exactly 4 bottom tabs: 'Início', 'Finanças', 'Tarefas', 'Mercado'.
Place the 'Perfil' (Profile) access as an Avatar icon in the top header of the Home screen, alongside the 'Acesso Founder' badge.
Place the 'Calendário' (Calendar) either as an icon in the header or as a prominent block within the Home dashboard.
Color Palette Rule: No blue, purple, or indigo used anywhere. Default to the rich Sage Green palette provided.

For the Home Hero card, STRICTLY IMPLEMENT the Gradient Scrim Pattern: Layer 0 = image, Layer 1 = vertical 3-stop linear gradient (transparent to >=80% surfaceInverse), Layer 2 = Glass effect + content (text onSurfaceInverse).
Ensure both Light and Dark modes are handled flawlessly. Background textures must shift accordingly.
Use a minimalist, Apple/Notion style for lists (Tarefas, Mercado) with prominent whitespace, subtle dividers, and high-contrast typography.
AI Financial Assistant should be accessible via a glassmorphism FAB on the Finanças screen.
